major bug fixes and AI overhaul
major bug fixes and AI overhaul

🔄 Offline Sync Fix

• Games played while app is offline now properly added to Playing
• Playtime minutes are now tracked and accumulated
• Fixed mid-game detection when opening app
• All game statuses properly handled

🔔 Custom Notifications (iOS)

• Added support for Bark notifications
• Game covers now appear in notifications!
• Minor stability improvements

🔧 Bug Fixes

• Fixed Alan Wake II crack status detection (Roman numerals now properly converted)
• Reverted hero animation that caused image display issues
• Improved PreDB search matching for games with sequel numbers

🔧 Bug Fixes

• Fixed inaccurate list counts (stale UUIDs cleaned up)
• Tracked games now properly deleted when removed from all lists
• Screenshot gallery now has smooth hero zoom animation
• Various stability improvements

🔵 Circular Liquid Glass Buttons

• Fixed buttons to be circular (not capsule)
• Blue checkmark tint restored
• Proper .buttonBorderShape(.circle) + .tint(.blue)
• Springy animations preserved

✨ Liquid Glass Polish

• All buttons now use proper iOS 26 GlassButtonStyle
• Springy bounce animations on all close/confirm buttons
• Consistent liquid glass look across the entire app

🔧 Bug Fixes & Polish

• Fixed AI Chat not using Foundation Models (was using fallback)
• AI Chat now properly uses smartChat with conversation memory
• Fixed Tool protocol conformance for Swift 6
• Fixed AppIntents parameter types for Siri shortcuts
• Unified close button style across all views
• Minor UI improvements

🤖 Massive AI Upgrade (iOS 26)

• Smart AI Chat with conversation memory
• Tool calling - AI can access library data
• Streaming responses with typing animation
• AI-powered game recommendations
• Creative smart list generation
• Siri shortcuts: 'What should I play?'

✨ Also includes:
• Liquid Glass UI updates
• Swift 6 strict concurrency
• Improved error handling
